basic_details.job_title: GMRC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Section Engineer and Engineer Sr Posts
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Limited, a 50:50 SPV of the Government of India and the Government of Gujarat, is inviting online applications for four posts on Contract/Deputation/Post-superannuation basis for a minimum of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance: one Section Engineer (Rolling Stock) O&M, Surat, one Section Engineer (Track), O&M, Surat, and two Engineer – Sr. Grade (Rolling Stock) for the Ahmedabad Metro Rail project. Pay is the revised IDA scale of 40000-125000 for the Section Engineer posts and ₹35000-110000 for Engineer – Sr. Grade. The essential qualif

age_limit.details: The maximum age is 32 years for both Section Engineer and Engineer – Sr. Grade, with age and experience reckoned as on 14 November 2026. The age limit is not applicable to GMRCL employees, but age relaxation does not apply to officials re-employed in GMRCL after superannuation.

qualification.details: Candidates working in revised IDA scale/CDA scale: minimum 2 years or more of experience in IDA pay scale of ₹35000-110000 or CDA pay scale or above in any Metro Rail/Railway/Railway PSUs/Govt. Organisation/PSUs, OR at least 5 years in revised IDA scale of ₹33000-100000 or equivalent CDA scale in Govt/PSU/Metro Rail Corporations. Candidates working in the private sector: should be working in a private organisation with monthly CTC of approx. ₹45,000/-. For Engineer – Sr. Grade, the notice prints no pay-scale or CTC condition in this table.

content_sections.heading: About GMRC
content_sections.text: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Limited is a Special Purpose Vehicle jointly owned by the Government of India and the Government of Gujarat. It is entrusted with implementing the Ahmedabad Metro Rail Project and the Surat Metro Rail Project and with their Operations & Maintenance. This notice is signed by the I/C General Manager (HR).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 4 vacancies in total across three posts. It states that the number of posts may vary based on further assessment of requirements. It does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience: minimum 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience of maintenance of Rolling Stock/M&P. Experience: minimum 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience in the field of maintenance of Civil Structures like Viaduct/Tunnel/Metro Stations/Depots/Ballasted, Ballast less. Experience: minimum 2 years of relevant experience like planning, preparation of technical specification, administration of contracts, installation, testing, commissioning, statutory approvals or maintenance of Rolling Stock system in railways/metros/other PSUs/private sector. Candidates with experience of working in modern urban metro rail systems will be given preference. The maximum age is 32 years for both Section Engineer and Engineer – Sr. Grade, with age and experience reckoned as on 14 November 2026. The age limit is not applicable to GMRCL employees, but age relaxation does not apply to officials re-employed in GMRCL after superannuation. Candidates working in revised IDA scale/CDA scale: minimum 2 years or more of experience in IDA pay scale of ₹35000-110000 or CDA pay scale or above in any Metro Rail/Railway/Railway PSUs/Govt. Organisation/PSUs, OR at least 5 years in revised IDA scale of ₹33000-100000 or equivalent CDA scale in Govt/PSU/Metro Rail Corporations. Candidates working in the private sector: should be working in a private organisation with monthly CTC of approx. ₹45,000/-. For Engineer – Sr. Grade, the notice prints no pay-scale or CTC condition in this table. Candidates working in Indian Railways, Metro Rail Organization, or a State or Central Govt. PSU/Board/Organization may apply on deputation on the standard terms and conditions of the parent organization, with other entitlements as per GMRC governing policies. Preference is given to candidates who have worked in Gujarat State for at least 3 years and are conversant with the Gujarati language. Eligible officials/staff of GMRC who have completed a minimum of two years of service as on 14 November 2026 in present designation and grade may apply through proper channel. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The posts are on Contract/Deputation/Post-superannuation basis for a minimum period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance, subject to the standard terms and conditions of the organization. For deputation, pay is as per standard terms and conditions. Apart from the pay, other benefits are paid as per Company Policy, and selected candidates get Group medical coverage and Group personal accident insurance as per GMRCL policies. For IDA/CDA scale employees, the percentage of HRA may vary with the place of posting as per Government guidelines and company policy.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications are accepted, through the "Careers" section of http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com . The notice gives these steps. Register on the portal with basic details such as name, date of birth, category, mobile number and email ID. Log in with the passcode sent to the email ID given at registration. Select the position for which you are applying. Fill in the online application with details from latest to earliest, and complete the application form. Check the entered details with the "preview" option. Submit the form after verifying all information; it cannot be edited after submission. The last date for submission of the application is 29 November 2026. Detailed curriculum vitae. Proof of age: Matriculation/Birth Certificate. Educational qualification: SSC/HSC marksheets, graduation all year/semester marksheets and degree/diploma certificates. Experience: experience/service certificates of past employments showing date of joining, date of relieving and department, with pay details clearly mentioning payscale/CTC. Private organisation candidates: latest CTC break-up with the other documents at the time of online application; without it the application will not be considered for the position applied. Form-16 is considered for arriving at the current CTC. Current organisation: appointment letter, proof of date of joining, latest payslip and Form-16 of the last three years.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises Personal Interviews followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination as per the category prescribed for the post. It judges different facets of knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness. Preference is given to candidates with experience in the same grade or immediate lower grade with 2 years' experience in the grade. If sufficient suitable candidates are not available, candidates from a lower pay scale who meet the prescribed qualifications, total experience and age criteria may be considered. Document verification is done before the interview. Candidates must carry original certificates, failing which they will not be allowed to attend the interview. Call letters stating time, date and venue are issued to shortlisted applicants through registered email. The interview date and venue are not given in the notice. Requests for a change of date or venue will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Section Engineer (Rolling Stock) O&M, Surat, 1 Section Engineer (Track), O&M, Surat, and 2 Engineer – Sr. Grade (Rolling Stock). The notice says the number of posts may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GMRC Section Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Section Engineer (Rolling Stock) needs B.E/B.Tech in Electrical/Electronics & Communications/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Power Electronics/Instrumentation engineering or an equivalent discipline, with 5 years' experience. Section Engineer (Track) needs B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering, with 5 years' experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years for both Section Engineer and Engineer – Sr. Grade, as on 14 November 2026. The age limit does not apply to GMRCL employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for GMRC Section Engineer and Engineer Sr. Grade?
faq.answer: Section Engineer posts carry the revised IDA scale of 40000-125000, and Engineer – Sr. Grade carries the revised IDA scale of ₹35000-110000. For deputation, pay is as per standard terms and conditions.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the "Careers" section of http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com. Only online applications are accepted, and the supporting age, qualification and experience documents must be attached.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is by Personal Interview, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination as per the category prescribed for the post. Document verification is done before the interview, so original certificates must be carried.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GMRC job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The posts are on Contract/Deputation/Post-superannuation basis for a minimum of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can employees of Railways or PSUs apply on deputation?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates working in Indian Railways, Metro Rail Organization or a State or Central Govt. PSU/Board/Organization may apply on deputation, and must submit an NOC with the last 5 years' APAR on or before the date of interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do private sector candidates need to attach anything special?
faq.answer: Yes. Private organisation candidates must submit their latest CTC break-up at the time of online application, or the application will not be considered for the position applied.
